source_clauses.verbatim: Design a foot pedal for a workbench.
Pressing it should send a signal to the machine
when I take my foot off it must return to its resting position on its own every time
It should not move if something brushes against it sideways.

requirements.statement_verbatim: Design a foot pedal for a workbench.
Pressing it should send a signal to the machine
requirements.observable_verbatim: Pressing the pedal results in a signal to the machine.

requirements.statement_verbatim: when I take my foot off it must return to its resting position on its own every time
requirements.observable_verbatim: Upon foot release, the pedal returns to its resting position on its own.

requirements.statement_verbatim: It should not move if something brushes against it sideways.
requirements.observable_verbatim: No movement occurs when a sideways force is applied.

scenarios.name: Pressing the pedal
scenarios.system_boundary: Inside: the foot pedal. Outside: the user's foot and the machine.

scenarios.name: Releasing the pedal
scenarios.system_boundary: Inside: the foot pedal. Outside: the user's foot and the machine.

scenarios.name: Sideways brushing
scenarios.system_boundary: Inside: the foot pedal. Outside: an external object that brushes against it.

freedoms.decision: Physical form, materials, and mechanism of the pedal
freedoms.why_free: The request does not specify design details.

freedoms.decision: Signal type and interface to the machine
freedoms.why_free: The request does not specify how the signal is sent or what kind of signal.
The request does not specify how the pedal returns to resting position.
The request does not specify how the pedal resists sideways motion.

ambiguities.statement: The exact lateral force required to not move is unspecified.

assumptions.statement: A foot pedal is a physical device that can be pressed by a user.
assumptions.why: The term 'foot pedal' implies a physical interface.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: A non-physical or virtual pedal design.

assumptions.statement: The machine accepts a signal from the pedal.
assumptions.why: The request states 'sends a signal to the machine'.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: The machine not being able to receive signals.
